subject: Consolidate SunBridge demo into one tight window?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Caleb Morgan <caleb.morgan@sunbridge.tech>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SunBridge: demo timing - request to tighten to one window

Hi all —

Heads up: Caleb and the SunBridge stakeholders are scheduled for a 60-minute demo tomorrow at 2pm PT, but our SE (Jonas) is double-booked for a partner briefing at the same time, and I need to travel for an onsite meeting right after (I won't be available to hand off).

Options to keep the meeting on track:
- Compress to a single 45-min walkthrough (demo + Q&A) and have Jonas remotely handle the technical portion; I can run the intro and outcomes.
- Keep 60 mins but push 30 minutes earlier so I can still make my flight (tight).
- Split into a 30-min intro with AE + SE follow-up later (not ideal given stakeholder availability).

Vanessa — can you cover the intro if we compress to 45? Jonas — can you present remotely if we shorten? Caleb — do any of the times below work if you prefer an earlier slot?

Proposed alternate slots (PT):
- Tomorrow 1:15–2:00 PM
- Tomorrow 1:30–2:15 PM
- Tomorrow 3:00–3:45 PM (if later works for stakeholders)

I attached a draft agenda to keep it focused. If we confirm, I'll send the consolidated invite + updated agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

Attachment: SunBridge_demo_agenda.pdf (1 page)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Caleb Morgan <caleb.morgan@sunbridge.tech>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SunBridge: demo timing - request to tighten to one window

Marissa — thanks for the heads-up. I can cover the intro and outcomes if we compress to 45 minutes; I’ll be remote in transit but have a stable connection. Jonas, can you commit to the technical deep-dive in a 20–25 minute block inside the compressed slot? If so, we should tighten the agenda to exactly: 5 min intro, 25 min demo/technical, 10 min Q&A, 5 min next steps.

I prefer the 1:30–2:15 PM slot (keeps me on schedule for my afternoon). If Caleb/Stakeholders are OK with 1:30 we’ll confirm and I’ll send a new invite.

Also — to reduce friction, I'll record and share the session for any stakeholders who miss the compressed window.

Vanessa

Thanks for the notice, Marissa. We do have a tight stakeholder window but 1:30–2:15 PM PT should work for most of the team here. Two quick asks:

1) Can you highlight (in the agenda) the specific parts of the demo that will show latency/cost improvements? That's the main focus for our CTO.
2) If Jonas will do the technical portion, could we get a one-slide list of what will be covered so we can route any pre-reading to our engineers?

If those two are included, confirm 1:30 and we'll be there. Appreciate the recording option — helpful for anyone who gets pulled into other calls.

—Caleb
